'''2001 Denver DPC''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Decipher Player Championship on 1 September 2001 at Tacticon in Denver, Colorado. 27 players came.<ref name="tr-pont">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-10-01-2001d2929/ denver-dpc-10-01-2001], Mark "The Maker" Ponting, DeckTech (4 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-10-01-2001d2929/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-christy">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-by-mystikald2924/ denver-dpc-by-mystikal], Dan "Mystikal" Christy, DeckTech (4 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-by-mystikald2924/ GitHub Pages].</ref> The Swiss cut to a final four. [[Hayes Hunter]] won, beating [[Brian Hunter]] in the final.<ref name="tr-pont" /><ref name="tr-hayes">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-14-hunters-crotch-peanut-dpc-denverd2961/ hunters-crotch-peanut-dpc-denver], Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, DeckTech (14 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-14-hunters-crotch-peanut-dpc-denverd2961/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 1 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Tacticon, Denver, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
